product: Improved Lakeflow Performance Observability will soon be available by default…
tagline: Starting on or after November 25, 2026, Improved Lakeflow Performance Observability will be available by default for eligible workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled.
what_it_does: Starting on or after November 25, 2026, Improved Lakeflow Performance Observability will be available by default for eligible workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled. Lakeflow Jobs now show query performance metrics and insights at the job level for supported tasks. You can view job level data volume metrics and use the Optimize button to open Genie Code to help improve queries with performance insights.
